title: Trigonometry & Right Triangles
summary: Master trigonometric ratios—sine, cosine, tangent (SOH-CAH-TOA)—and learn how to calculate unknown sides, angles, and real-world distances.
focus: Right-angled triangles, Hypotenuse, Opposite, Adjacent, Sine, Cosine, Tangent, and the Pythagorean Identity.

cues.text: Qrie AI ki is demo class mein aapka swagat hai! Trigonometry right-angled triangle se shuru hoti hai. Ek angle exactly 90 degrees hota hai, aur 90 ke opposite wali longest side ko hypotenuse kehte hain.
Jab hum ek reference angle theta choose karte hain, to baaki do sides ke specific names hote hain: theta ke samne wali opposite side, aur sath wali adjacent side.
Notice kijiye reference angle badalne par opposite aur adjacent swap ho jate hain, lekin hypotenuse hamesha 90 degree ke samne fixed rehta hai.

chapters.title: The Primary Ratios: Sine and Cosine

cues.text: Sine ratio opposite side aur hypotenuse ko compare karta hai: sine of theta equals opposite over hypotenuse. Jaise theta badhta hai, sine zero se one tak grow karta hai.
Cosine ratio adjacent side aur hypotenuse ko compare karta hai: cosine of theta equals adjacent over hypotenuse. Zero degrees par cos one hota hai aur 90 degrees par zero.
Sine aur cosine milkar unit circle par kisi bhi point ke exact coordinates determine karte hain, aur wave geometry ko link karte hain.

chapters.title: Tangent and the SOH-CAH-TOA Memory Tool

cues.text: Third primary ratio hai tangent: tangent of theta equals opposite over adjacent. Tangent incline ke slope ya steepness ko bhi represent karta hai.
Dhyan se sochiye: kaun sa legendary acronym teeno fundamental trig definitions ko unite karta hai?
Famous acronym yaad rakhiye: S-O-H C-A-H T-O-A. Sine is Opposite over Hypotenuse, Cosine is Adjacent over Hypotenuse, aur Tangent is Opposite over Adjacent.
SOH-CAH-TOA ke saath, agar aapko ek side aur ek acute angle pata ho, to aap triangle ki har missing dimension calculate kar sakte hain.
Opposite squared plus adjacent squared equals hypotenuse squared hota hai, isliye fundamental identity milti hai: sine squared plus cosine squared always equals one.
Surveyors, astronomers, aur GPS satellites trigonometry ka use karke mountain heights aur orbit distances directly measure karte hain.
Qrie AI ki ye demo class complete hoti hai! Whiteboard par notes review kijiye aur apne Professor se koi bhi doubt poochiye.

notes.title: The Core Trigonometric Ratios (SOH-CAH-TOA)
notes.text: For any acute angle θ in a right-angled triangle, the three primary ratios compare side lengths: Sine = Opposite / Hypotenuse, Cosine = Adjacent / Hypotenuse, and Tangent = Opposite / Adjacent.
notes.equation: sin θ = Opp/Hyp · cos θ = Adj/Hyp · tan θ = Opp/Adj

notes.title: The Fundamental Pythagorean Identity
notes.text: Derived directly from the Pythagorean theorem (a² + b² = c²), dividing all terms by the square of the hypotenuse yields the most famous identity in trigonometry: sin² θ + cos² θ = 1.

notes.title: Special Right Triangle Exact Values
notes.text: 30°-60°-90° and 45°-45°-90° triangles produce exact ratio values: sin(30°) = 1/2, cos(30°) = √3/2, sin(45°) = √2/2, and tan(45°) = 1.

mistake: Don’t mix up Opposite and Adjacent when changing which angle you analyze. The Opposite side is strictly opposite angle θ, while Adjacent is the touching side that is not the hypotenuse.

practice.question: In a right triangle with angle θ, if Opposite = 3 and Hypotenuse = 5, what is sin(θ) and what is the Adjacent side length?
practice.answer: sin(θ) = 3/5 = 0.6. By Pythagoras (c² = a² + b²), Adjacent = √(5² - 3²) = √(25 - 9) = √16 = 4.
